stages.description: Generate T-pose reference image for terrorist character
Generate 3D models: pistol, rifle, shotgun, terrorist, bomb, ammo crate
Generate 7 enemy motions + 9 player hand motions via MoMask text-to-motion + retarget
Generate urban warfare scene with alley and warehouse
Generate gunfire SFX, explosion SFX, and radio dialogue (TTS)
Generate C# gameplay code: FPSPlayerController, WeaponSystem, WeaponSwitchSystem, FPSHitSystem, EnemyAI, EnemySpawner, BombObjective, FPSDamageSystem, FPSHUDController
Generate UI/HUD code: crosshair, ammo, health, weapon slots, mission info, kill notification, defuse progress
Generate CG-3 counter-terrorism warehouse assault video (25s)

mvp_loop.name: FPS Tactical MVP Playable Loop
steps: Launch Unity and load UrbanWarfare scene
Player spawns at start position with pistol equipped
Player moves with WASD, sprints with Shift, jumps with Space
Player aims and fires with mouse, muzzle flash and bullet holes appear
Player hits enemy, enemy takes damage and plays hit reaction
Enemy dies with death animation (fall forward/back)
Player switches weapons with 1/2/3, each has different stats
Player approaches bomb, defuse prompt appears
Player holds E, defuse progress bar fills
mvp_loop.failure_condition: If any step breaks, pipeline reports failure and triggers self-repair (max 3 attempts per stage)

categories.name: Launch
checks: Weapon model visible in first person

categories.name: Weapon System
checks: Each weapon has different fire rate and damage

categories.name: Enemies
checks: Enemies patrol when player not detected
Enemies shoot at player when detected
Player takes damage from enemy fire

categories.name: Objective
checks: Mission text visible (Eliminate enemies / Defuse bomb)
